title: Chicken Shawarma
description: Quick stovetop Middle Eastern chicken, marinated with authentic spices and seared hot for charred, tender strips.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, whisk together vegetable oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, paprika, cumin, cardamom, red chilli flakes, and cinnamon.
Add chicken strips to the marinade and stir to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.
Heat a large frying pan or wok over high heat until very hot.

Add the marinated chicken strips in a single layer. Cook for 2–3 minutes without moving to get a good sear, then stir-fry for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through and slightly charred at the edges.
Remove from heat and serve immediately over rice or in pita with pickles, tomatoes, lettuce, and garlic or tahini sauce.

notes.title: Marinating Time
notes.content: Minimum 1 hour marinating is required. For best results, marinate overnight — the lemon and spices will tenderise the chicken deeply.

notes.title: Hot Pan
notes.content: The pan must be very hot before adding the chicken. A quick, hard sear gives the charred edges that define shawarma. Avoid overcrowding — cook in batches if needed.

notes.title: Recipe Inspiration
notes.content: Inspired by traditional Middle Eastern shawarma techniques.
